clues: This town sits on a big river in a wide farm valley in the north of its state. A large river delta spreads out just to its west.
Summers here are very hot and dry, while winters are cool and wet. Almost all the rain falls from October through April each year.
A man named Charles Maria Weber set up this town in 1849, in the gold rush years. He bought ranch land and used its river spot to grow rich.
This town built the first Sikh temple in the whole United States. Sikh faith first found a home of its own here, long ago.
The oldest college in its state has stood here since 1923. The school was first chartered in 1851, long before most towns in the west.
